RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown—these facts do not support a defensible numerical estimate.

An all-male panel is worth asking about, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications warrant serious consideration; the announcement alone cannot show how the candidates compared against the selection criteria.

Follow up in writing requesting the reasons, assessment criteria, your scores and any applicable panel-composition rules. Frame the concern neutrally: “What safeguards ensured a fair, non-discriminatory assessment?”

Whether panel composition breaches any rule—and whether two weeks exceeds a response deadline—depends on your jurisdiction. Check complaint deadlines now; waiting for reasons may not suspend them. A union or equality body can advise.
